Surjat Ali Fakir (Md) and others ----- Defendant-Petitioner
Vs.
Md Kasum Ali Fakir and others ----- Plaintiff- Opposite Parties
full_judgment: 7. The learned Advocate for the petitioners has placed before me the application under section 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure filed by the defendants as well as the impugned judgment and order. On perusal of the impugned judgment it appears that the learned District Judge clearly found that the present suit brought for partition of the land under CS khatian No. 234 though the land of the present suit was not included in the schedule of the earlier suit being partition suit No. 79 of 1970 and, as such, without trial it cannot be said that the suit is barred by principle of res judicata.
